'''6C''' was the room number of a small apartment owned by the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Borkus/Legends|Borkus]] and rented by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]], in [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]], on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]]. Gregor lived there after he went missing in action in the [[Battle of Sarrish/Legends|Battle of Sarrish]], [[Amnesia/Legends|lost his memory]] and started working as a dishwasher for the Pons Ora diner [[Power Sliders/Legends|Power Sliders]], also owned by [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] Borkus.<ref name="Missing in Action" />

According to Gregor, the salary he was paid as a dishwasher could barely pay the rent for his apartment. Due to its cheap price, the quality of the apartment was not good and it was infested with bugs. After some [[Time/Legends|time]] Gregor was found there by the [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]], and he later helped them to escape from the remote planet, sacrificing himself.<ref name="Missing in Action" />
